title: Claude Fable 5 returns
summary:
Claude Fable 5 returned with image input, tools, and a large context; the README made room for a community chat app.

Claude Fable 5 was restored as a paid-only text model through the chat completions API. It accepts text and up to 20 reference images, supports tools, and has a 1 million-token context.

Requests use adaptive thinking and omit sampling parameters the model rejects. Token billing distinguishes input, cached reads, cache writes, and output.

The README’s Latest News section added Flow Linnom, a community multi-model chat interface, in place of an older Generative Soundscape entry.

highlights.title: Claude Fable 5 returns
highlights.text: Use the paid-only Claude Fable 5 model for text, up to 20 reference images, and tool calls, with a 1 million-token context. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
